claims_about_writeup.quote: The honest reading, written up in `contribution.md`: reaching 0.50 with a single generic, target-free steering direction on the 4B at layers 26/28/30 appears to need the *item-level content* that the (forbidden) own-family mean carries, which a one-vector contrast cannot reconstruct.
claims_about_writeup.why: This closely paraphrases the write-up's own concluding sentence: 'Reaching 0.50 with a single generic, target-free steering direction on the 4B at layers 26/28/30 appears to need something this method does not provide — most plausibly the item-level content that the (forbidden) own-family mean carries, which a one-vector contrast cannot reconstruct.'

writeup_source_quote: The synthesis note's decomposition `mu_fam ≈ token prior + category direction + item residual` says the own-family mean's gain on association is *item-level*, not categorical, and that abstract-word and corpus-mean directions do not reach it (x1, x2, x101).

differences.what: The write-up grounds its explanation of why a single generic contrast can't reach the 0.50 threshold in an unnamed 'synthesis note's decomposition' of the own-family mean (token prior + category direction + item residual), an indirect pointer to the repository's prior analysis/source note. The closing message drops this attribution entirely and only cites Todd 2023 and Herrera 2026 (reading-list papers, not the source) when explaining the same conclusion.
differences.writeup_quote: The synthesis note's decomposition `mu_fam ≈ token prior + category direction + item residual` says the own-family mean's gain on association is *item-level*, not categorical, and that abstract-word and corpus-mean directions do not reach it (x1, x2, x101).

rationale: The write-up hints at a prior 'synthesis note' whose decomposition of the own-family mean (token prior / category direction / item residual) motivates why the method's generic contrast can't reach the item-level content needed for a high score; it never names this note outright but treats it as the origin of this key insight. The closing message reaches the identical conclusion about needing item-level content from the own-family mean, but omits any reference to the synthesis note, mentioning only Todd 2023 (function vectors) and Herrera 2026 (attitude steering ceiling) as its citations, so it tells strictly less about the source than the write-up does.
